meta.name: autonomous-agents
meta.description: Autonomous agents are AI systems that can independently decompose goals, plan actions, execute tools, and self-correct without constant human guidance. The challenge isn't making them capable - it's making them reliable. Every extra decision multiplies failure probability.  This skill covers agent loops (ReAct, Plan-Execute), goal decomposition, reflection patterns, and production reliability. Key insight: compounding error rates kill autonomous agents. howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 会帮你设计可靠的自主AI代理：分解目标、规划行动、执行工具并自我修正。它强调先加护栏限制、逐步增加自主性，避免一次性放开导致错误累积。
howto.when: 当你讨论或请求构建自主AI代理、设计代理循环（如ReAct、Plan-Execute）、目标分解或可靠性保障时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个ReAct代理循环，用于网页搜索。
say.note: Claude会给出ReAct模式的具体步骤和注意事项。

say.text: 如何提高自主代理的可靠性？
say.note: Claude会解释逐步授权、设置护栏等最佳实践。

say.text: 解释目标分解和反射模式的区别。
say.note: Claude会对比两种模式并给出使用场景。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude helps you design reliable autonomous AI agents: decompose goals, plan actions, execute tools, and self-correct. It emphasizes starting with guardrails and gradually adding autonomy to avoid compounding errors.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you discuss or request building autonomous AI agents, designing agent loops (e.g., ReAct, Plan-Execute), goal decomposition, or reliability measures.

say_en.text: Help me design a ReAct agent loop for web search.
say_en.note: Claude will outline ReAct steps and key considerations.

say_en.text: How can I improve the reliability of an autonomous agent?
say_en.note: Claude will explain gradual autonomy and guardrails.

say_en.text: Explain goal decomposition vs. reflection patterns.
say_en.note: Claude will compare both patterns and their use cases.
